Name: Operating checking
Notes: The company's own money: fees earned and company bills

Name: Trust checking
Notes: Owners' rent, tenants' security deposits and reserves. Never the company's money

Name: Fees receivable
Notes: Fees earned and not yet moved from trust at month end

Name: Prepaid expenses
Notes: Insurance and software paid ahead

Name: Accumulated depreciation
Notes: Contra account; carries a credit balance

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Company bills only. Owner repairs are paid from trust against the owner's balance

Name: Tenant security deposits held
Notes: Owed to tenants until the lease ends and deductions are worked out. Never income

Name: Owner funds held
Notes: Parent line. Rent collected for owners minus their repairs, fees and distributions

Name: Owner funds held: Owner A
Notes: One child per owner. Rent credits it; repairs, the management fee and owner distributions debit it

Name: Owner funds held: Owner B
Notes: Rename to the owner or property

Name: Prepaid rent
Notes: Rent received before the month it covers

Name: Owner reserves held
Notes: Optional. Repair reserves an owner leaves in trust

Name: Business credit card
Notes: Company spending only

Name: Members' capital
Notes: The management company's own owners

Name: Members' draws
Notes: Draws by the company's owners. Owner distributions to property owners go through 2210 and 2220 instead

Name: Management fees
Notes: Earned when rent is collected, moved from trust to operating once a month

Name: Leasing fees
Notes: Charged to the owner when a new lease is signed

Name: Maintenance markup
Notes: Only if your management agreements allow it

Name: Late fee share
Notes: Only the part the agreement gives the manager; the rest belongs to the owner

Name: Maintenance staff wages
Notes: In-house technicians whose time is billed to owners

Name: Maintenance materials
Notes: Materials bought for jobs billed to owners

Name: Licensing and education
Notes: Broker or manager license and required courses

Name: Insurance
Notes: Errors and omissions, general liability

Name: Advertising vacancies
Notes: Only if the company pays; owner-paid listings come out of the owner's balance

Name: Bank fees
Notes: Operating account fees. Trust account fees are not paid with owners' money unless the agreement says so
